items.title: Pill to treat pancreatic cancer hailed as ‘biggest breakthrough in decades’
items.standfirst: Cancer undetectable for one in 12 patients in daraxonrasib trial, while nearly all participants’ tumours stopped growingA pill that can shrink and potentially eliminate pancreas tumours is being hailed as the biggest breakthrough treatment for the cancer in decades.In one in 12 of the patients given the drug, daraxonrasib, during a trial, the cancer became undetectable, and the tumours stopped growing in almost all of the 61 patients. The trial participants had recently been diagnosed with advanced pancreatic cancer that had spread to other parts of the body. Continue reading...

clusters.title: Can depression really become dazzling dance? The biggest ever BalletBoyz show is a huge feat
clusters.neutral_headline: Can depression really become dazzling dance? The biggest ever BalletBoyz...

items.title: Can depression really become dazzling dance? The biggest ever BalletBoyz show is a huge feat
items.standfirst: Sadler’s Wells, LondonIn Six Lethargies, Iván Pérez and Seirian Griffiths have devised a mammoth production of aching, ethereal sadness‘If I write what I feel, will you feel it, too?” That was the question behind singer-songwriter turned composer Keaton Henson’s Six Lethargies. Perhaps that is every artist’s mission, but for Henson it was specifically his experiences with anxiety and depression that he wanted to translate into music. Now it has been turned into dance by the BalletBoyz. If they dance it, will we feel it?Six Lethargies is the largest production in the 25-year history of the BalletBoyz. Once just two ex-Royal Ballet dancers, Michael Nunn and William Trevitt, this iteration is a company of 44 dancers (male and female), a 37-piece string orchestra, and not one but two choreographers working together: former Dance Theatre Heidelberg artistic director Iván Pérez and talented newcomer Seirian Griffiths. Continue reading...

items.title: How to start eating plant-based, without missing out on nutrients or foods you enjoy
items.standfirst: Experts agree that if you’re thinking of changing your diet, start small and keep your goals in mindAt this point, the environmental effects of the meat industry have been well-established: one 2021 study found that meat accounts for nearly 60% of all greenhouse gases from food production, and a 2025 report estimated that animal agriculture was responsible for 12%-19% of total human-caused greenhouse gases.According to the United Nations, one of the best things people can do to reduce their personal carbon footprint is shift from a diet heavy in meat to one that is more plant-based. Many of us know this, but in the US and UK, fewer than 5% of adults identify as vegetarian or vegan. One of the biggest obstacles, according to experts? People think it’s too hard. Continue reading...
